title: Functions: default parameters (slugify)
prompt:
Write makeSlug(string $title, string $separator = '-', int $maxLength = 0): string that turns a title into a URL slug:

  1. lowercase everything
  2. replace every run of characters that are not a–z or 0–9 with ONE separator
  3. remove separators from the start and end
  4. if $maxLength > 0, cut the slug to at most $maxLength characters, then remove any trailing separator again

  makeSlug("Hello World")            → "hello-world"
  makeSlug("Hello World", "_")       → "hello_world"
  makeSlug("  PHP  is   Fun!! ")     → "php-is-fun"
  makeSlug("PHP is Fun", "-", 7)     → "php-is"   ("php-is-" after cutting, then trimmed)

hints: preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', $separator, $slug) replaces every run of unwanted characters with one separator. Do strtolower() first.
trim($slug, $separator) removes the separator from both ends; rtrim() only from the end.
substr($slug, 0, $maxLength) cuts the string. Only do it when $maxLength > 0, then rtrim again.
solution:
<?php
function makeSlug(string $title, string $separator = '-', int $maxLength = 0): string
{
    $slug = strtolower($title);
    $slug = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', $separator, $slug);
    $slug = trim($slug, $separator);

    if ($maxLength > 0) {
        $slug = substr($slug, 0, $maxLength);
        $slug = rtrim($slug, $separator);
    }

    return $slug;
}
